title: Why RSI Over 70 Is Not a Sell Signal
description:
https://www.signumhq.com

RSI above 70 is called overbought, and almost everyone reads that as a sell signal. It is not one.

RSI compares average gains to average losses over 14 days. Above 70 only means gains have dominated. It says nothing about what comes next.

So we counted. Across 12 large caps since 2021 there have been 386 days where RSI(14) crossed above 70. Five days later they were higher 57% of the time — against 53% on any given day. A four point gap, z = 1.48. That is noise.

AMD crossed 70 three times this spring and was higher five days later every time: +13.6%, +26.2%, +9.1%.
